## About
HyperMotion Design and Landscape is woman owned and operated, and the work is overseen by the designer, Aimee. She's passionate for plants, flowers and rock, and every job gets a personalized touch.
We're on County Road 167, just north of Myers Park in McKinney. Our garden center has trees, perennials, organic milkweed, bushes and shrubs, fruit trees, vegetables and herbs. Landscapers are welcome to shop here too.
Aimee, Lori and the crew have a 4.9 rating from 43 Google reviews. Come see the plants, or call and tell us what your yard needs.

## Services
- Three-dimensional raised flower beds: Raised beds with premium soil and mulch, planted to attract butterflies and hummingbirds, with planting solutions for shady spots and all sunny beds.
- Natural stone patios: Hand-carved natural stone patios built with attention to detail.
- Stone steps, pathways and walkways: Add dimension to your yard, solve trouble areas and create focal points with stone.
- Eye appealing drainage solutions: Dry river beds and natural french drains for drainage and gutter problems, built with natural stone, Colorado river rock and Baja rock.
- Borders and edging solutions: Swap cracked cement, plastic or metal edging for hand-carved, fitted natural stone that also works as a weed barrier.
- Tree planting: Instant tree, instant shade, instant beauty. Japanese Maples are our specialty.
- Water features: One reviewer called the natural stone water feature in their yard amazing and unique.
- Trees, shrubs and plants for sale: Our garden center carries trees, perennials and annuals, and one customer found a good selection of native plants.

## FAQ
Q: Can I shop when nobody is there?
A: Yes. We have posted hours, but you're welcome to shop anytime. The gate is always open.

Q: How do I pay if I shop on my own?
A: Prices are marked. Leave your cash or check in the lock box, or call us to pay by credit card.

Q: Can landscapers buy from you?
A: Yes. Our garden center is both wholesale and retail, and landscapers are welcome to shop here.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're in McKinney, just north of Myers Park.

Q: How do I reach Aimee about a project?
A: Call 972.523.8120 or e-mail aimeeschu@yahoo.com, or fill in the contact form and we'll get back to you about your landscaping needs.

## What customers say
- "We bought our house a few months ago and took ownership of a backyard that was never cared for. Weeds, ailing shrubs, uneven slope, drainage issues - all the good stuff :) We wanted to get a full-fledged back yard makeover. We got the designs using Yardzen.com. We then started getting quotes from landscapers.

We spoke to 10 landscaping companies and got quotes from six of them. Most of these followed a similar pattern. They would come in - take a look at the designs, do a quick site walkover and quip an estimate the next day. There were all "yes men" - no suggestions or changes to the design. When we spoke to Aimee from Hypermotion Landscaping, she was different right off the bat. She glanced at the Yardzen design for about 15 seconds. She said the designs might be beautiful but are definitely not practical.The patio was placed on the far right off the yard which hardly got any breeze. The tree placement was not ideal based on the slope off the yard. Some of the plants were placed in a spot where they would get burnt with excess sunlight. Moreover, Aimee found some foundational issues which had happened due to soil erosion over the years.

Aimee gave us an estimate which was about 12-15% more than the others. The difference was that her quote handled all the foundational issues of the house and she was using flag stone rather than cheap pavers. Moreover, Aimee owns a nursery and her knowledge of plants is second to none. Here's a small little caveat - Aimee is a bit old school and not very structured. She only corresponds using concise emails and not texts. There are no auto-cad designs or breakdown of the estimate. We had to take a leap of faith and we are so glad that we did.

Aimee and her crew spent two weeks on our project. They were right on time everyday. Aimee got our feedback at every step and incorporated our requests. As the work started, they found some issues with the sprinkler system. Aimee got everything done in the same initial quote. She also helped us get the HOA off our backs by taking care of our front yard (added plants and mulch) without any additional cost.

Aimee has our highest recommendation. You won't regret working with her! Thank you for the awesome work, Aimee." (Akmal Muqeeth, 5/5)
